name: lynkgrids
description: Lynkgrids is your LinkedIn CRM, the outreach tool that finally remembers your customers. A sales engagement CRM for teams that sell on LinkedIn: find the people you sell to, keep every conversation as a tracked lead, and handle replies, all from chat.

interface.shortDescription: Lynkgrids is your LinkedIn CRM, the outreach tool that finally remembers your customers.
interface.longDescription: Lynkgrids is a sales engagement CRM for teams that sell on LinkedIn. Other tools get you the reply and then drop you. Lynkgrids keeps every conversation as a tracked lead, from first hello to closed. From Claude you can describe your ideal customer and get leads, score your own connections against it and add the fits to a list, enrich contacts from their profiles, write the messages and follow-ups for a list, comment on a prospect's latest post, and handle replies. You see and approve every message before it goes to anyone.
defaultPrompt: Find 50 Heads of Sales at B2B SaaS companies in India and add them to a list.
Check my LinkedIn connections and put everyone who fits my ideal customer into the list Q4 founders.
Who replied to my campaigns this week, and draft replies for them.
